primary_rejection_reason: Agency business model - marketing, content, SEO and web-design services, which the brief excludes explicitly
secondary_rejection_reasons: Rejected on business model, not on keywords. DoctorLogic self-describes across its own site as a 'Healthcare Marketing Agency', a 'Healthcare Content Marketing Agency for Doctors' and a medical website design service, and its service list - website design, local SEO, content marketing, paid advertising, reputation management - is agency work delivered on a proprietary platform rather than a software product sold on subscription. That hits four separate entries on the exclusion list (marketing agency, content agency, SEO agency, web-design agency). Headcount is also contested and trending above the band (47 / 65 / 72 across sources). Noted for a reviewer: a genuine website platform does underpin the service, so if Status Quo ever widens the TAM to software-enabled services this is the borderline case to revisit. Founded 2013 by Stuart Lloyd (co-founder/CEO) and Ray Myers.
hard_disqualifier: Agency business model - marketing, content, SEO and web-design services, which the brief excludes explicitly
